definitions.explanation: A bag or case used for carrying belongings on a trip. Covers everything from suitcases and duffel bags to large travel backpacks.

examples.japanese: {旅行鞄|りょこうかばん}に{荷物|にもつ}を{詰|つ}めた。
examples.english: I packed my things into the travel bag.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{旅行鞄|りょこうかばん}を{買|か}おうと{思|おも}っている。
examples.english: I'm thinking of buying a new suitcase.

examples.japanese: {空港|くうこう}で{旅行鞄|りょこうかばん}が{見|み}つからなくて、{係員|かかりいん}に{相談|そうだん}した。
examples.english: I couldn't find my luggage at the airport, so I consulted a staff member.

notes:
Composed of {旅行|りょこう} (travel) + {鞄|かばん} (bag). A somewhat formal or traditional-sounding compound. In everyday conversation, many speakers simply say スーツケース (suitcase) or キャリーバッグ (wheeled carry bag) for specific types.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {旅行鞄|りょこうかばん}に{詰|つ}める: to pack into a travel bag
- {旅行鞄|りょこうかばん}を{持|も}つ: to carry a travel bag
- {大型|おおがた}の{旅行鞄|りょこうかばん}: a large suitcase
- {旅行鞄|りょこうかばん}を{預|あず}ける: to check luggage

SIMILAR WORDS:
- スーツケース: suitcase — specifically a hard-shell or semi-hard rolling case
- キャリーバッグ: carry bag — a wheeled travel bag, common loanword in Japan
- {鞄|かばん}: bag — the general term for any bag
- トランク: trunk — an older term for a large, sturdy suitcase
